onboarding · product requirements · in review · 2026-08-05

PRD: Signup Flow

Replace password-and-verify signup with magic links, and move profile questions to after the first successful login.

Problem

Activation drops 40% at the email-verification step: users create a password, get bounced to their inbox, and a large share never come back. The password itself serves no product purpose — sessions are long-lived and sensitive actions re-authenticate anyway.

40%drop at verification
75%target completion
2 wksmeasurement window

Proposal

Magic-link signup with progressive profiling after first login: the form asks for an email address and nothing else. The link both verifies the address and starts the session — one step instead of three. Profile fields arrive later, one question at a time, inside the product.

Success metrics

Signup completion above 75% within two weeks of launch, measured from form view to authenticated session. Guardrails: no rise in support tickets about lost access, and median time-to-signed-in under 60 seconds.

MetricTodayTarget
Form → session completion~52%≥ 75%
Median time to signed in4m 10s< 60s
Verification-step abandonment40%< 10%

Out of scope

  • SSO / social login — separate track, different risk profile.
  • Password removal for existing accounts — follows only after this ships and holds.
